summary: Pulse Biosciences filed an 8-K disclosing board approval to allow affiliates to purchase common stock via an existing at-the-market equity distribution agreement with TD Cowen, without a discount. The agreement allows sales up to $60M. Co-Chairman Robert Duggan (72% owner) and CEO Paul LaViolette indicated likely near-term purchases at prevailing bid prices, but no binding commitment. No specific price, premium, or closing date. This is an insider buying permission, not a buyback tender. Watch for actual insider purchases; no arbitrage.
